name: skyline-grok
description: Wires the skyline MCP daemon into Grok: HTTP MCP server (port 7333) + PreToolUse enforcement that steers native Grok tools (read_file, search_replace, grep, list_dir, run_terminal_command) to skyline_* MCP tools with exact substitutes when the daemon is reachable (fail-open when not), plus a once-per-session Stop skylore deposit prompt.
